subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the workspace or rejected by fs-safe?
rationale: The branch can only be accepted as written if maintainers intentionally broaden the read-scoped file metadata boundary; otherwise it needs a boundary-preserving redesign before merge.

options.title: Keep Workspace Containment
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the UX by filtering, hiding, or neutral-labeling external paths while preserving fs-safe-only metadata.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend
options.body: Keep only any still-needed CSS repair and handle external/directory Missing semantics in a separate reviewed backend/UI design.

options.title: Accept External Metadata
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external path metadata intentionally, but require explicit security acceptance and protocol/UI tests before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep Workspace Containment
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the UX by filtering, hiding, or neutral-labeling external paths while preserving fs-safe-only metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace-file preview work preserved the same containment boundary and is the closest current-main owner signal for the security/product choice.
